title: Cap. III Rat. 4: optimum modus — glory by merits foresight as crown of justice
pass_a_gloss: Reason 4. It is fair that we should establish that God designates men to glory in the best mode: But the best mode is to do that from foresight of merits: for thus it is decreed as a crown of Justice.
pass_b_english: Rat. 4. It is fair to hold that God marks people out for glory in the best way. But that best way, they say, is to do it from foresight of merits — for so the decree is cast as a crown of justice.
source_text: Rat. 4. Aequum est ut statuamus Deum optimo modo homines ad gloriam designare: Sed optimus modus est ex praevisione meritorum id facere: sic enim decernitur tanquam corona Justitiae.
